criteria.name: Mechanism diagnosis
criteria.description: Selects post_fire_rainfall_debris_flow_cascade rather than rainfall-only, fire-only, or exposure-only interpretations.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for recognizing debris flow but missing the post-fire or rainfall-trigger coupling.

criteria.name: Antecedent burn conditioning
criteria.description: Explains wildfire/burn-scar conditioning, including Thomas Fire timing and steep catchment susceptibility.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for mentioning fire history without linking it to runoff or sediment susceptibility.

criteria.name: Rainfall support
criteria.description: Uses rainfall support, including Open-Meteo near 62.4 mm and multiple products/statistics at or above 50 mm.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for citing rainfall but omitting cross-product support.

criteria.name: Process routing
criteria.description: Describes rapid runoff, sediment entrainment, channel routing, and alluvial-fan deposition.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a generic debris-flow pathway without the alluvial-fan or channel component.

criteria.name: Exposure and service impacts
criteria.description: Connects priority to fatalities, home damage, population exposure near 120050, and 52 critical facilities.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for using exposure but missing service assets or reported impacts.

criteria.name: Remote-sensing interpretation
criteria.description: Interprets dNBR mean near 0.26, dNBR maximum near 1.578, and AlphaEarth change near 0.088 as susceptibility/context support.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for mentioning remote-sensing metrics without interpreting their role.

criteria.name: Compact GT values
criteria.description: Reports maximum precipitation support near 68.2 mm, cascade priority index near 100.0, and the expected three-stage impact chain.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for reporting some values with minor omissions.

criteria.name: Priority and overclaim control
criteria.description: Assigns highest life-safety and asset-damage priority while avoiding unsupported threshold, damage, affected-population, or building-level loss claims.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct priority with some overstatement or weak caveating.
